guideline: The map option keyboard defaults to true. It makes the map focusable and enables arrow and +/- navigation; keyboardPanDelta defaults to 80 px.
keywords: keyboard; keyboard accessibility; focusable; arrow keys; keyboardPanDelta; tabindex
do: Keep keyboard enabled so the map can be focused and panned with arrows and zoomed with +/-.
dont: Set keyboard:false on an interactive map.

guideline: The 2.0 reference adds the ariaKeyShortcuts map option so assistive tech can learn the shortcuts.
keywords: ariaKeyShortcuts; aria; screen reader; shortcuts; leaflet 2.0
do: On Leaflet 2.0 use ariaKeyShortcuts so assistive technology can announce the map shortcuts.
dont: Expect screen readers to discover shortcuts unaided.

guideline: Documented keys: Tab/Shift+Tab (map, markers, controls), arrows pan, +/= and -/_ zoom, Shift gives 3x step, Enter/Space on a marker opens its popup, Esc closes a popup or the layers list.
keywords: keyboard keys; tab; arrows; shift; enter; space; escape; popup; shortcuts
do: Design custom widgets to coexist with these built-in keys.
dont: Override Tab, arrow, Enter, Space or Esc handling on the map.

guideline: Nothing on the map announces the keyboard shortcuts, so list them near the map.
keywords: keyboard help; shortcut list; instructions; discoverability; help text
do: Print the keyboard shortcut list in the page next to the map.
dont: Assume users will guess the keys.

guideline: The marker option keyboard (default true) lets a marker be tabbed to and activated with Enter.
keywords: marker keyboard; focus marker; tab to marker; Enter; marker option
do: Leave marker keyboard enabled for interactive markers.
dont: Disable marker keyboard on markers that open popups.

guideline: Every marker needs a unique alt or title, which becomes its accessible name. DivIcons need their own label in the HTML.
keywords: marker alt; marker title; accessible name; divIcon; screen reader label
do: Give each marker a unique alt or title and add a label inside DivIcon HTML.
dont: Leave markers unnamed or give them identical names.

guideline: Purely decorative maps should have the HTML inert attribute so they are hidden from assistive tech and not focusable.
keywords: inert; decorative map; hide from screen reader; focusable; static map
do: Add inert to the container of a map that carries no information.
dont: Leave a decorative map in the tab order.

guideline: A fullscreen mode is recommended for keyboard, screen-reader and mobile users (FullscreenControl in the 2.0 docs).
keywords: fullscreen; FullscreenControl; mobile; keyboard; screen reader
do: Offer a fullscreen control for the map.
dont: Force small embedded maps as the only view on mobile.

guideline: The zoomControl and attributionControl map options default to true.
keywords: zoomControl; attributionControl; default controls; map options
do: Remember both controls are on by default; disable zoomControl only if you supply an equivalent.
dont: Remove zoom controls without an alternative for keyboard and touch users.

guideline: The AttributionControl collects text from layers via getAttribution; addAttribution(text) adds more and setPrefix(false) removes the prefix.
keywords: attribution; addAttribution; setPrefix; getAttribution; leaflet prefix
do: Set attribution on layers and use addAttribution for extra credits.
dont: Remove all attribution text from tile and data layers.
code_bad: map.attributionControl.setPrefix(false); // and no layer attribution at all

guideline: Attribution for Mapbox and OSM in Leaflet is done with addAttribution().
keywords: mapbox in leaflet; osm attribution; addAttribution; openstreetmap
do: Add the Mapbox and OSM credits with addAttribution when using their tiles in Leaflet.
dont: Use Mapbox or OSM tiles in Leaflet with no credit.

guideline: markercluster options: maxClusterRadius 80 (px), disableClusteringAtZoom null, spiderfyOnMaxZoom true, showCoverageOnHover true (also on keyboard focus), removeOutsideVisibleBounds true, chunkedLoading false, animate true.
keywords: markercluster; cluster; maxClusterRadius; chunkedLoading; spiderfy; showCoverageOnHover; many markers
do: Use L.markerClusterGroup for dense markers and enable chunkedLoading when adding many at once.
dont: Add thousands of plain markers directly to the map.

guideline: The Leaflet accessibility guide asks you to test with the keyboard alone and with a screen reader.
keywords: testing; keyboard only test; screen reader test; manual audit
do: Test the map using only the keyboard and with a screen reader before release.
